bio: Situated on the north Norfolk coast, The Grove is a beautiful Georgian House which overlooks picturesque landscaped gardens, the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  The grove is only a short walk from the town centre and within easy reach of the stunning villages along the coast.  Afternoon Tea at the grove is a truly special occasion which can be enjoyed in the restaurant, lounge, conservatory or gardens. You can enjoy a selection of savoury finger sandwiches, freshly baked scones with homemade preserves and clotted cream and a selection of traditional, fruit and herbal tea.
